entries.text: OK, you’re all registered as a contestant. Please\nhead down to the battle court.

entries.text: Welcome, one and all, to another thrilling\nAcademy Ace Tournament!
entries.label: sub_012_announce_00

entries.text: Let’s get right to it and kick off the first round!\nWho will the fates pair up today?!
entries.label: sub_012_announce_01

entries.text: Next up is the second round! I’m sure you’re\nready to hear the matchup, so let’s get to it!
entries.label: sub_012_announce_02

entries.text: Finally, only four Trainers remain! Time for our\ncontestants to face their third matches, everyone!
entries.label: sub_012_announce_03

entries.text:
There’s one last match in this tournament, ladies
and gentlemen.\c
These two Trainers will be facing off to finally
determine who’s the strongest in the academy!
